pub fn measured_release_profile() -> &'static str {
    r#"[profile.release]
lto = \"fat\"
codegen-units = 1
opt-level = 3
strip = true
"#
}

pub fn benchmark_evidence() -> &'static str {
    "LTO measured: 12% improvement on bench/serde_bench"
}

pub fn benchmark_reference_exists() -> bool {
    benchmark_evidence().contains("measured")
}
